title: [self-tests/helpers] minutesOfUtcDay: characterization test for minutes of the UTC day at the bounds
body:
Target: PeaceG03/PeaceAI-Workspace

add a characterization test for minutesOfUtcDay in peaceai/self-tests/helpers/dates.ts: utc minute bounds
- minutesOfUtcDay(new Date("2026-10-16T00:00:00Z")) is 0
- minutesOfUtcDay(new Date("2026-10-16T23:59:59Z")) is 1439
- minutesOfUtcDay(new Date("2026-10-16T12:30:00Z")) is 750

(Builder pre-file, TEST_CASE_EXISTING, public-test-case-existing-v1): Peace's task (source: peace). The existing helpers test checks one value; this pins both ends of the day (seconds are dropped).
